formulas: Mileage Deduction Formula: prop("Trip Distance") * (prop("IRS Rate Year") == "2024" ? 0.67 : 0.655)
Self-Employment Tax Reserve (15.3% on 92.35% of Net): round(prop("Net Income") * 0.9235 * 0.153 * 100) / 100
Total Estimated Tax Reserve Formula: prop("Self-Employment Tax Reserve") + (prop("Net Income") * prop("Estimated Federal Bracket")) + (prop("Net Income") * prop("State Tax Rate"))
COI Status Formula: now() > prop("COI Expiration Date") ? "🚨 EXPIRED" : (dateBetween(prop("COI Expiration Date"), now(), "days") <= 30 ? "⚠️ EXPIRING SOON" : "✅ ACTIVE")
views: CPA Tax-Ready Export View (Grouped by Schedule C Category, filtered by Tax Year)
Active Contracts Pipeline (Board view grouped by status: Onboarding, Active, Renewal, Completed)
Quarterly Tax Estimate Summary (Table view showing Gross, Deductions, Net, and Estimated Tax Reserves per quarter)
Expired Compliance Alerts (List view filtered for expired COIs or missing W-9s)
Monthly Expense Burn Chart (Board view grouped by month of transaction)

frequently_asked_questions.question: Can I import transactions from my bank account?
frequently_asked_questions.answer: Yes! While Notion doesn't natively connect to live bank feeds, Contractor OS includes a dedicated CSV Import Mapper. You can download your transaction history from your bank and import it into the system in under two minutes.

frequently_asked_questions.question: Does this template work with the free version of Notion?
frequently_asked_questions.answer: Absolutely. Contractor OS is fully compatible with the free personal plan of Notion. You do not need a paid Notion subscription to use any of its features.

frequently_asked_questions.question: How are the tax formulas calculated? Are they accurate for my state?
frequently_asked_questions.answer: The system calculates federal self-employment tax (15.3% on 92.35% of net income) automatically. It also includes adjustable fields for your estimated federal income tax bracket and your specific state's income tax rate, allowing you to tailor the reserve calculations to your exact location and financial situation.
